name: FxROM / MMC4

components.role: Nintendo MMC4 package with 16 KiB PRG banking, fixed 8 KiB PRG RAM, PPU-address tile-trigger CHR latches and mirroring control

connections: PPU A0..A13 + RD -> mapper tile-trigger decode
notes: Mapper 10 / FxROM is replaceable external hardware. CPU $8000-$BFFF is one switchable 16 KiB PRG window and $C000-$FFFF is fixed to the final 16 KiB bank; $6000-$7FFF is fixed 8 KiB PRG RAM/NVRAM. Each 4 KiB CHR window selects between FD/FE registers. MMC4 decodes both low and high PPU trigger ranges ($xFD8-$xFDF / $xFE8-$xFEF) and switches after the triggering read. Mirroring is live mapper state; there is no IRQ, CHR RAM or CPU/ROM bus conflict.
